name: logtura
description: Configure and operate the open-source Logtura CLI and forwarder across supported log sources and destinations. No Logtura account is required.

interface.longDescription: Configure and operate the open-source Logtura CLI, library, and forwarder across supported log sources and destinations. Set up standalone forwarding, filters, deployments, delivery verification, and provider integrations. A Logtura account is optional; website synchronization is available for linked deployments.
interface.defaultPrompt: Configure this project's log forwarding with open-source Logtura and verify delivery.
